## Reporting Support

- Records identified from recorded searches: partially_supported — Recorded provider totals and entered records are available, but they are not guaranteed unique records and source categories are not modeled.

- Records screened: partially_supported — The application reports current canonical Papers at title/abstract screening, not a complete formal screening flow over reports.

- Duplicates removed: partially_supported — Slice 10 exposes current canonical resolution and a derived collapsed-record surplus, not a formal persisted duplicate-removal event count.

- Reports sought or retrieved: partially_supported — The application records Paper-level retrieval attempts, but Paper is only a nearest report proxy and process-history events are not formal PRISMA report counts.

- Reports sought: partially_supported — Nearest proxy is Papers ever sought (at least one retrieval attempt); this is a historical Paper-level fact, not a report event count.

- Reports retrieved: partially_supported — Nearest proxy is Papers ever retrieved successfully; later unavailable attempts do not erase this historical fact.

- Reports not retrieved: partially_supported — Only current unavailable retrieval state is available; this must not be read as never retrieved, so formal historical not-retrieved reporting is not claimed.

- Reports assessed for eligibility: partially_supported — Current full-text decisions are recorded for canonical Papers, but reports sought/retrieved and historical PRISMA event flow are not modeled.

- Reports excluded after full-text review: partially_supported — Current full-text exclusions and structured reasons are recorded for canonical Papers, not a separate report entity.

- Studies included after eligibility: partially_supported — Current final inclusion is derived from both screening stages on canonical Papers; distinct study/report identity is not modeled.

- Automation-tool exclusions: unsupported — Automation exclusion stages are not modeled.

- Database/register/other source categories: unsupported — No persisted reporting taxonomy exists; actual SearchSource labels are retained.

## Reporting Limitations

- This is a derived review-flow report and does not claim formal PRISMA 2020 compliance.

- Automation-tool exclusion counts are not modeled.

- No database/register/other-source taxonomy is persisted; actual SearchSource labels are reported instead.

- Recorded searches report more results than have been entered as RetrievedRecords; ingestion may be partial or intentional.

- Some RetrievedRecords have no current Paper match.

- Some duplicate candidate pairs remain unadjudicated.

- Some Papers remain unscreened at the title/abstract stage.

- Some Papers remain in the application-specific maybe state.

- Some Papers have no historical acquisition link.

- Some Papers retain historical acquisition provenance but no current record link.

- Some Papers are linked through more than one SearchSource; per-source Paper counts are non-additive.

- Current retrieval state includes pending or unavailable Papers; these are operational states, not historical PRISMA event counts.

- Some historical full-text decisions predate retrieval tracking; no retrieval readiness or historical success is inferred.

- Some retrieval history belongs to Papers no longer currently included at title/abstract screening.
